hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ "$fp" == *".harness/"*".md" ]] || exit 0; at=$(basename "$fp" .md); bash spec/bootstrap/validate-artifact.sh "$at" "$fp" # baton-validate-artifact

input=$(cat); fp=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ "$fp" == *"module-status.md" ]] || exit 0; nc=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // empty' 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$nc" ]] || exit 0; ns=$(echo "$nc" | awk -F'|' 'NR>2 && NF>3 && $4!~/---/{gsub(/ /,"",$4); print $4; exit}'); [[ -n "$ns" ]] || exit 0; [[ -f "$fp" ]] || exit 0; cs=$(awk -F'|' 'NR>2 && NF>3 && $4!~/---/{gsub(/ /,"",$4); print $4; exit}' "$fp"); [[ -n "$cs" ]] || exit 0; bash spec/bootstrap/validate-transition.sh "$cs" "$ns" # baton-validate-transition
